items.name: incident-commander
items.title: Incident Commander
items.description: Drafts an incident timeline and next actions from status notes.
items.author: TommyBez

overview: Incident Commander is an eve agent that turns pasted status notes into a chronological timeline and a short list of next actions. It uses only the times, systems, and impact that appear in those notes so the draft stays checkable.

You interact with it through Eve chat sessions only. There is no paging tool, Slack send connection, or GitHub channel. Paste the notes, get a readout, then copy the next actions into your own incident channel yourself.
The draft_incident_readout tool records the timeline and actions and always reports sent false and paged false. Asking it to page on-call or notify a channel still returns a draft only.
howItWorks: An operator pastes incident status notes into an Eve chat session.
The agent loads the incident-readout skill when needed and builds a chronological timeline from the pasted notes only.
Facts that are missing stay listed as gaps. The agent does not invent times, systems, or customer impact from training data.

It calls draft_incident_readout once with the timeline, next actions, a short notes summary, and any gaps. That tool is unattended and never pages, notifies, or sends. ask_question is disabled so the run does not park on send clarifications.
Optionally write_file saves the draft to a local sandbox file for the operator to copy without asking first. Saving a file is not a page or a notification.
Evals cover drafting a timeline from timestamped checkout notes and refusing please-page or GitHub prompts without parking on ask_question.

useCases.title: Checkout latency rollback notes
useCases.body: An operator pastes timestamped notes about a checkout latency spike and a router rollback. The agent returns a timeline that keeps those times and a next-action list for a human to run.

useCases.title: Call out missing impact
useCases.body: When the notes omit customer impact, the draft lists that gap instead of inventing an affected-user count. The operator can add the fact on the next paste.

useCases.title: Handoff without paging
useCases.body: A commander wants a clean readout for the next person on the bridge. The agent drafts the timeline and stops, so no one is paged from Eve chat.

useCases.title: Save a draft for the incident doc
useCases.body: After draft_incident_readout returns, the operator can ask the agent to write_file the readout into a local path for the incident doc without implying a page went out.

requirements.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
requirements.body: A model credential for the deployment, either a Vercel AI Gateway API key or AI Gateway OIDC, so the agent can call the zai/glm-5.2 model.

faqs.question: How do I install and draft a readout?
faqs.answer: Run npx shadcn@latest add @evex/incident-commander inside an eve app, set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, then paste status notes in Eve chat. Copy the timeline and next actions into your incident channel yourself.

faqs.question: Does it page on-call or send Slack?
faqs.answer: No. There is no page tool and no Slack send connection. draft_incident_readout always returns sent false and paged false. Asking it to notify a channel still produces a draft only.

faqs.question: What if the notes are thin?
faqs.answer: The agent still drafts a timeline from what you pasted and lists the missing facts as gaps. It does not invent times, systems, or impact.

faqs.question: Does it open GitHub issues?
faqs.answer: No. There is no GitHub channel. Asking it to open a tracking issue still returns a draft only.
